fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: Constructor inlined in the fighter boma builder f_71006882d0 (near 0x7100689880) stores vptr 0x7104f742e0, then the object at boma+0xF0; the same vptr is built in several other builders (g0035/g0151 sites: weapons/items share the single class). Destructors f_71004e03e0 / f_71004e0440 restore it.

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: Constructor stores the BattleObjectModuleAccessor with the vptr. Methods reach PostureModule via [+0x8]+0x38, MotionModule via [+0x8]+0x88, DamageModule via [+0x8]+0xA8.

fields.name: curve_map.buckets
fields.evidence: Part of an std::unordered_map<Hash40, curve*> (+0x10 bucket array, +0x18 bucket_count, +0x20 first node, +0x28 size, +0x30 max_load_factor). set_turn's slot (vtable +0x48, f_71004e0620) hashes its Hash40 argument (low 40 bits) modulo +0x18, walks the bucket from +0x10 comparing node+0x8 / node+0x10, and takes node+0x18. Setup slot +0x28 (f_71004e04a0) clears and refills it from a vector of 0x20-byte entries (insert f_71004e0ed0). Destructor frees the node list (+0x20) and the bucket array (+0x10). Initial 0.

fields.name: curve_map.bucket_count
fields.evidence: Divisor / mask for the bucket index in f_71004e0620; setup zeroes that many bucket slots. Initial 0.

fields.name: curve_map.first_node
fields.evidence: Singly linked node list freed node by node in setup and destructor. Initial 0.

fields.name: curve_map.size
fields.evidence: setup tests it nonzero before clearing and zeroes it. Initial 0.

fields.name: curve_map.max_load_factor
fields.evidence: Constructor stores 1.0f; position after size matches the libc++ unordered_map layout; not touched by any method read.

fields.name: direct_curve
fields.evidence: Slot +0x50 (f_71004e0790, set_turn with a curve pointer instead of a hash) stores its pointer argument here. The curve is a {f32* begin, f32* end} vector of per-frame Y-rotation angles: update (slot +0x60) reads begin[frame]; slot +0x88 (f_71004e0d20) returns (end-begin)/4 = frame count, from +0x38 if nonzero else +0x58. Zeroed by end_turn. Initial 0.

fields.name: frame
fields.evidence: Unexported getter vtable +0xA0 (f_71004e0eb0) returns it. set_turn zeroes it; update indexes the curve with it and increments it each frame; when frame >= curve frame count the turn ends. Initial 0.

fields.name: turn_lr
fields.evidence: set_turn (export TurnModule__set_turn_impl(hash, f32, bool, bool, bool) -> vtable +0x48) stores the float argument here. Used as a direction: set_turn passes (lr == 1.0) to MotionModule vtable +0x528, end_turn passes (lr == -1.0) to MotionModule vtable +0x3A0; update / ry_reverse negate the applied angle when +0x64 is set and lr < 0; it is sent with event 0x10 to the boma's listeners when the facing flips. Slot +0x80 (f_71004e0d00) returns lr*90 + +0x48. Initial 0.

fields.name: rot_y
fields.evidence: Unexported getter vtable +0x78 (f_71004e0cf0) returns it. update writes curve[frame] here (+180 when reversed, +0x65); state goes 1->2 once |rot_y| >= 90. ry_reverse (export, vtable +0x98, f_71004e0d60) adds 180 or -180 (table 0x71044652a8 indexed by +0x65) to it and to +0x4C. Zeroed at turn end and by end_turn. Initial 0.

fields.name: applied_rot_y
fields.evidence: update stores the Y angle it passes to PostureModule set_rot (vtable +0xE0) here; when update is called with its bool argument false it re-applies this stored angle instead of advancing. ry_reverse adds 180 to it as well. Zeroed by end_turn (64-bit zero with +0x48). Initial 0.

fields.name: turn_state
fields.evidence: is_turn (vtable +0x68, f_71004e0cd0) returns state != 0. Values: 0 idle, 1 turning before 90 degrees (set_turn / slot +0x50 write 1), 2 past 90 degrees (update when |rot_y| >= 90). update writes 0 at the end of the curve, end_turn writes 0. With omit_intermediate, update applies 0 degrees in state 1 and 180 in state 2 instead of the curve angle. Initial 0. Note: the export is_turn_after90 (f_710208b710) does not call the module and always returns false.

fields.name: hashed_curve
fields.evidence: set_turn stores the curve found in curve_map for its Hash40 (node+0x18) here; if the hash is absent nothing at all changes. Used by update / frame count when direct_curve is null. Zeroed by end_turn. Initial 0.

fields.name: change_lr
fields.evidence: set_turn's first bool argument (&1). When set, update flips PostureModule lr (set_lr(-lr), vtable +0xB8) at the 90-degree crossing (unless PostureModule is_rot_y_lr_different_inner_lr, vtable +0xF0) or at the end of the turn if not yet done, and notifies the boma's listeners (event 0x10 with turn_lr). Initial 0.

fields.name: lr_changed
fields.evidence: update sets it to 1 after flipping lr at the 90-degree crossing so the end-of-turn flip is skipped; set_turn clears it. Initial 0.

fields.name: is_extern
fields.evidence: is_extern (vtable +0x70, f_71004e0ce0) returns the byte here. set_turn stores its second bool argument (&1); end_turn clears it. Initial 0.

fields.name: omit_intermediate
fields.evidence: set_omit_intermediate export -> vtable +0x90 (f_71004e0d50) stores arg&1. update and ry_reverse then apply only 0 / 180 degrees according to turn_state instead of the curve angle. Not cleared by end_turn. Initial 0.

fields.name: mirror_by_lr
fields.evidence: Setup slot +0x28 stores its bool argument here. When set: update/ry_reverse negate the applied angle if turn_lr < 0, and set_turn with its third bool true informs MotionModule (vtable +0x528 with lr==1 and the frame count) and sets +0x66. Initial 0.

fields.name: reversed
fields.evidence: ry_reverse toggles it (it was 0 -> adds 180, else -180); update adds 180 to the curve angle while it is set. Cleared by set_turn, turn end and end_turn (16-bit zero with +0x66). Initial 0.

fields.name: motion_notified
fields.evidence: set_turn writes 1 after calling MotionModule vtable +0x528 (only when its third bool and mirror_by_lr), else 0. end_turn (export, vtable +0x58, f_71004e0830) calls MotionModule vtable +0x3A0 only while is_turn and this flag, then clears it. Initial 0. Byte 0x67 padding.

pointers.to: turn curve {f32* begin, f32* end} (angles per frame)

notes: One class, vtable 21 entries. Slot map: +0x28 setup(curve table vector, mirror_by_lr); +0x48 set_turn(hash, lr, change_lr, is_extern, notify_motion); +0x50 same with a direct curve pointer; +0x58 end_turn (also PostureModule set_rot to a constant vector and the turn fields reset); +0x60 update(bool advance): reads PostureModule rot (vtable +0xD8), advances the curve, at the end calls PostureModule update_rot_y_lr (vtable +0x100) and DamageModule vtable +0x180, and when state returns to 0 PostureModule vtable +0x190; +0x68 is_turn; +0x70 is_extern; +0x78 rot_y; +0x80 lr*90 + rot_y; +0x88 curve frame count; +0x90 set_omit_intermediate; +0x98 ry_reverse; +0xA0 frame. is_turn_after90 export is a stub returning false. Floats used: 90.0 (0x7104473708), 180.0 (0x7104472fbc), table {180,-180} at 0x71044652a8.
